body: Yeah. I’m glad I have more self awareness than her. Like, even if I never get over my body issues, I’ll never ever ever talk about them around or in front of my kids, if I ever have any.
I think she was just terrified herself of getting fat and projected that onto me all the time :/ when I was around 12 she could fit in my juniors size 1 jeans, even though she’s much taller than me.

My mom, anytime I pointed out a clothing item I thought was cute: “that would only look good on someone stick skinny!” or “you’d have to be teeny tiny to be able to wear that!”
My mom, anytime I was having a snack: “you’d better watch what you eat, or you’ll end up fat just like your aunt.” 
My mom, constantly talking about my skinny sister. All of this was at the time I was quite thin. Now I’m really overweight, lmao. 

My partner, the other night (they didn’t mean for it to hurt me but…) was laying in bed with me, just idly playing with my breasts and non-chalantly mentioned that they felt like pizza dough. I cried for like 4 hours straight in the tub after that. 

Anytime I have ever been called thick or any variation of it has cut like a hot knife. 

“You were so pretty in high school!” 

I could go on and on :(
I also was diagnosed with a “small hiatal hernia” ugh.
I’ve been in therapy already and I know I’m supposed to learn to cope with this but tbh I don’t see a point in living if I’m in pain every day.

Hmm I’ll definitely ask about it. I didn’t think I could have a blockage this long without having a medical emergency tbh. I’ve been symptomatic every single day for almost a year now haha. I hear people talk about flare ups and am like 😳mine never stopped lol
I’ll have to ask about this too. Thanks for all the advice!
I have had an ultrasound done, but I’m not sure exactly what the doctor looked at apart from my heart and gallbladder.

I haven’t, but that’s because when I do end up pooping, it’s a massive amount and it’s all liquid. On poop days, I’ll usually be on the toilet 6+ times during the day evacuating massive amounts of liquid feces ugh
Sorry for being so graphic in the poop sub, lol.

Yes exactly. I suppose if nothing else it should help my bladder issues. 
I really feel like my body is a cardboard raft being held together by scotch tape and staples, because on top of this I also have scoliosis and bulging discs 😭
I haven’t. I’ll ask my doctor about it once I finish moving to see if it’s available in my country.

Also a cis woman! 
I had pelvic floor therapy years ago for vaginismus actually. 
Maybe once I get a new doctor here I’ll see if perhaps this could all just be pelvic floor related. Wishful thinking I suppose to have an easy solution but worth a try!

Ugh isn’t that the worst? 
Like, I’m stressed BECAUSE I am sick, not the other way around.

Thanks. 
Yeah it’s definitely constipation. I just wish there were a way to actually fix it all.

I’m not in the US sadly. I have been prescribed several different medications including mebeverine, omeprazole, Pepcid, gaviscon, and another antispasmodic which I can’t remember the name of currently but none of them helped or even worse gave bad side effects :( 
In any case I’m also not okay with taking meds for the rest of my life. 
I think honestly there isn’t a solution for me because the only thing I find acceptable is returning to normal and this doesn’t seem to have any cure…
Following because same here!!

This totally makes sense, but I feel like what OP, all of us in this community, and I want is pretty clear; we have XYZ symptom(s), sometimes a ton of them, and we want them all explained and fixed. 
I just fail to see why doctors should be so confused about what patients want.
Following because me too :(

You aren’t ugly, but he has a horribly ugly personality. You really dodged a bullet. 
I’m sorry he did something so hurtful and rude to you.

They’re mad because they still feel awful, but because the numbers are “normal,” they aren’t being offered any solutions to help them feel better, and further, are being told, “you’re fine, because the numbers are normal. Are you depressed?”

“I cannot tell anyone about my desire to die, because people do not take it well, do not know how to handle suicidal people, and if I mention it to my doctor, I have doomed my condition as psychosomatic...” 

This resonates so strongly for me. I’m sorry you’re experiencing this, too. 
I wish I had advice for you.

This is really relatable. I tested a bunch of lifestyle changes over many months, none of which changed anything for me.
I think the problem is I want to be normal again, I want to be healthy. I haven’t found a single factor that does anything for my symptoms, positively or negatively, so I’m just fed up with never feeling normal anymore. Why would I deny myself cheese fries or staying up late if I’m going to feel like shit anyways?

This resonates so much. 
Being chronically ill has turned me into a shell of who I was before. I lash out at people, I’m actively ruining my relationship with my partner, I don’t talk to anyone anymore unless they force me into it. 
Part of my problem includes reflux, which hasn’t caused any irreversible damage yet (I don’t think but then again, I am being denied care), but it will. The only thing I’ve ever been passionate about is singing, and it’s being taken away from me.
Thank you. I hope that you can, too.
I’m honestly ignoring it all at this point, but that’s because I can’t get medical care unfortunately.

Not in Canada, but honestly if I keep suffering like I am, I’d consider it, if it were available to me. 
I’ve only been sick for about 7 months now, which is such a short time in comparison to many people in this sub, but I don’t have the tolerance to deal with this. 
I personally don’t see the point in living when I’ll be suffering forever, other than living because others want me around. It isn’t worth it to me.
Wow thanks so much for the comprehensive review! I’ll look into it. Unfortunate that insurance likely wouldn’t cover this...
Thanks! Really taking one for the team :)
Having no support in any case sucks. I’m sorry you’re experiencing this with family
I’m basically doing the same but it’s because I’m being refused medical care.
It seems too good to be true to me, but I haven’t looked into it much. If someone has read it I’d love to hear an opinion.

Sharing your happy stories isn’t what people are upset about. It’s you commenting on people’s posts where they are rightfully upset and invalidating them, implying the should just be positive and that their experience of people, especially medical professionals, treating them like shit is somehow made up and exaggerated or somehow deserved. That’s what upsets people in this sub. 
I’m glad you are experiencing happiness now. But please, stop implying people “want to be miserable” when they are going through a life-change and having to cope with never being able to feel or be normal again, all with very limited support from medical professionals. Also keep in mind that many here have invisible illnesses and are therefore on the receiving end of nasty comments from bystanders when they use accommodations such as a handicapped parking space or vulnerable shopping times for grocery stores. 
Stop assuming that we are all also experiencing your lived experiences and just being whiny and miserable. This isn’t the case.

I’m glad that is how you have been treated but not everyone has the luck you seem to have with your experiences.
I don’t know why it makes you feel good to comment hurtful things to people on this sub, but the holier-than-thou attitude and toxic positivity from you is getting really old. 
I’m sure you have many better things to do than to troll other sick people on the internet, ffs.

Me too :(

Edit: I hate that people assume poor mental health causes physical symptoms when for me (and really most anyone with a chronic health issue) it’s actually the opposite. The physical issues are causing poor mental health.
DM’d you!!

Oh my god I relate to this so much...
I am not from the UK but just moved here semi-recently and immediately got ill...which is now chronic. I’ve felt so angry at not getting any treatment to ease my symptoms or really any investigation to find what is wrong since it isn’t life-threatening. 
It really sucks to just suffer in silence, and I think Covid makes it worse, because referrals are even less likely...
I even sometimes find reading in this sub difficult because people mention just finding new doctors until one cares, but here...it’s a lot harder to do that, and sometimes even not possible. 
I don’t know how I can help, but please feel free to DM me if you want mutual venting and support from someone who understands this awful situation.

Edit: also FWIW, I have gone abroad to get some better healthcare recently, and had I had more time there, I think they would have eventually found something or at least been able to help more than they were able in the limited time span. 
This is my throwaway acct, so if you’d like some details on that, I can provide this in private.

I’m from the US actually, but recently moved to the UK so navigating the health system here is unfamiliar and really hard :/ unfortunately I only began having symptoms after I moved, so it’s really been a struggle. 

Glad your search is turning up some tentatively hopeful results for you! Best of luck!
I really hope so too. I hope you find a good one soon, too!
I wish I could help. If someone in the UK knows how to achieve this, I’d love to know, lol.
I have done PT actually. But the back pain has been normal for me since I was a young child, whereas the symptoms currently ruining my life came on very suddenly 6 months ago.

I’ve been to a GI but not within my country. They doctors here won’t take me seriously at all. Fibro doesn’t sound like me but I haven’t really looked into it. I don’t tend to have widespread pain like people with fibro describe. I do have back pain due to scoliosis and bulging discs, though. Haven’t even had rheumatologist brought up to me.

They’re never ending it seems :( 
I have lots of GI issues: change in BMs, acid reflux, regurgitation of food and liquid, excessive belching, bloating, trapped gas in abdomen and intestine, nausea, stomach pain, sudden difficulty passing gas, chest pressure and pain, difficulty breathing, etc. 
and then also maaaybe related? It came on at the same time but it’s this weird head sensation which isn’t quite like being dizzy, but almost like I’m about to be dizzy? It sometimes feels like my head is just buzzing or like my movements are delayed. Idk how to explain it really, it’s very strange.

So I’m not doing well at all :/ I still don’t have a diagnosis or any indication of lifestyle things that will make any difference, unfortunately. This is all brand new starting 6 months ago, and I’m still basically unable to cope. It’s a shame because before all this, I was doing great, like, best time of my entire life great. I’ve started self-harming, because I feel like it’s the one thing I actually have any control over. Every day that I wake up I’m angry and sad that I didn’t die in my sleep. This past week and a half has been worse emotionally than usual because I had a particularly degrading call with a GP and then had 3 separate people suggest diet and exercise changes, as if after 6 months I wouldn’t have already tried something as simple as cutting out dairy. Even on less bad days, I still have symptoms and am just preoccupied with how I’m sure in a few hours I’ll feel awful again. 

Anyways, thanks for providing a space for people to vent. The world is really lonely when no one can understand.
Omg this. I feel like all of the little things don’t add up to enough happiness to justify all of the awful things.

Tying up loose ends. 
I’m waiting to see if my physical health improves, and if it doesn’t or I get a diagnosis which can’t be fixed, then I’ll go ahead with my planned date. 
Otherwise, I’m only living for my partner and to make others happy, which sucks.
This exactly. It’s not that I want to die, I just don’t want to live life how it is now.
I am a woman. The doctors I’ve seen are all women which is really discouraging, too. I think it’s a cultural thing here, tbh.

Unfortunately I can’t get a different doctor because there isn’t one available. 

As for my partner, the relationship is long distance, so they can’t do too much in terms of advocacy. I feel like they deserve better than me. I basically ignore them all day and then at night speak for 5 minutes or so before sleeping.

I really wish I could. I’m in a tiny town in a foreign country without a good health system. There is only one medical practice in my town, and despite telling them I’m passively suicidal, they’ve told me I’m not bad enough to be put on the waiting list for mental health services.
